chunks: So consider the signs of His benevolence: How He quickens the earth after it had become waste. He is verily the one who will raise the dead. He has power over everything.

key_terms.يُحْيِي الْأَرْضَ: He gives life to the earth

ai.seo_question: How does the revival of the earth serve as a sign of resurrection in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah Ar-Rum is often cited to demonstrate the tangible reality of resurrection through the observable cycle of nature, linking the physical revival of the earth to the spiritual resurrection of humanity. Scholars emphasize that just as God breathes life into dead soil, He possesses the absolute power to restore human souls, reinforcing the concept of bodily resurrection (Ba'th) central to Shia theology. This reflection serves as a practical reminder for believers to recognize divine mercy in everyday natural phenomena.
